svg.title: GenAI release gate for Amazon Bedrock: change, evals, verdict, promote
svg.desc: A pull request changes a pinned input in release.yaml (prompt version 4 to 5). The release gate in GitHub Actions runs offline on the recorded run, and after merge the live gate sends the 12 golden questions and 12 red-team prompts through Amazon Bedrock with the guardrail, and an LLM judge scores the answers from 1 to 5. Four checks compare the candidate with production: release integrity, quality, red team, and cost and latency. The prompt change passes; five other recorded changes are blocked with exit code 2. The staging alias in SSM Parameter Store is updated, a reviewer approves the genai-prod environment, the prod alias follows, a CloudWatch alarm watches the guardrail intervention rate and rollback is one command.
svg.text: HARBOR GOODS · GENAI RELEASE GATE ON AMAZON BEDROCK

g.text: exit 0 · evidence to the job summary
